SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER WHERE USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'SHIPPING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipping FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS IN ('PAID','READY','SHIPPING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RENTALS WHERE RENTAL_STATUS = 'IN_USE'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.month_date, '%m월') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.TOTAL_PRICE), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AS month_date UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') ) m LEFT JOIN ORDERS o ON DATE_FORMAT(o.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(m.month_date, '%Y-%m') AND o.ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELLED','REFUND') GROUP BY m.month_date ORDER BY m.month_date ASC

SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, O.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, O.TOTAL_PRICE AS totalPrice, MIN(P.PRODUCT_NAME) AS productName FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.CREATED_AT ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, TITLE AS title, USER_ID AS userId, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%m/%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM INQUIRY WHERE INQUIRY_STATUS = 'WAITING' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiry
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, PRICE AS price, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount FROM PRODUCT WHERE IS_AVAILABLE = 'Y' ORDER BY VIEW_COUNT DESC LIMIT 5

mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS SALES_DATE, COUNT(ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUND') GROUP BY SALES_DATE ORDER BY SALES_DATE DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID AS RENTAL_ID, R.USER_ID AS USER_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME,
(SELECT IMG_URL FROM product_img PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LIMIT 1) AS IMG_URL, DATE_FORMAT(R.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(R.RETURN_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS AS RENTAL_STATUS, CASE WHEN R.RENTAL_STATUS = 'IN_USE' THEN '대여중' WHEN R.RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_COMPLETED' THEN '반납완료' ELSE R.RENTAL_STATUS END AS RENTAL_STATUS_KOR FROM rentals R JOIN product P ON R.ITEM_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY R.START_DATE DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE rentals SET RENTAL_STATUS = #{status} WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId}
UPDATE rentals SET RETURN_DATE = #{returnDate} WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId}

mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET INQUIRY_STATUS = 'ANSWERED' WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}
UPDATE user SET USER_STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() /* 언제 바뀌었는지 기록 남기기 */ WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT e.EVENT_ID, e.TITLE, DATE_FORMAT(e.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(e.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DATE, ei.IMG_URL AS THUMBNAIL, /* ⭐ 상태값 세분화 */ CASE WHEN NOW() < e.START_DATE THEN 'READY' /* 시작 전 */ WHEN NOW() BETWEEN e.START_DATE AND e.END_DATE THEN 'ING' /* 진행 중 */ ELSE 'END' /* 종료됨 */ END AS STATUS_CODE FROM event e LEFT JOIN event_img ei ON e.EVENT_ID = ei.EVENT_ID AND ei.IS_MAIN = 'Y' ORDER BY e.START_DATE ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event

AND USER_STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, COUNT(CASE WHEN USER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS ACTIVE, COUNT(CASE WHEN USER_STATUS = 'DELETED' THEN 1 END) AS DELETED, /* 최근 30일 이내 가입자 수 예시 */ COUNT(CASE WHEN CREATED_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS NEW_MONTH FROM user

SELECT MAX(C.CAMP_ID) AS CAMP_ID, C.CAMP_NAME, C.ADDRESS, C.INDUTY, MAX(I.IMG_URL) AS IMG_URL FROM camp C LEFT JOIN camp_img I ON C.CAMP_ID = I.CAMP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (C.CAMP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.ADDRESS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY C.CAMP_NAME, C.ADDRESS, C.INDUTY ORDER BY CAMP_ID DESC
SELECT C.*, I.IMG_URL FROM camp C LEFT JOIN camp_img I ON C.CAMP_ID = I.CAMP_ID AND I.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE C.CAMP_ID = #{campId}
mapper.update: UPDATE camp SET CAMP_NAME = #{campName}, ADDRESS = #{campAddress}, INDUTY = #{campType}, DESCRIPTION = #{campContent} WHERE CAMP_ID = #{campId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUPON_ID, COUPON_NAME, COUPON_TYPE, DISCOUNT_AMT, DISCOUNT_RATE, MIN_ORDER_AMT, ISSUE_TARGET, IS_ACTIVE, DATE_FORMAT(ISSUE_START_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(ISSUE_END_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DATE FROM coupon WHERE 1=1 AND COUPON_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY COUPON_ID DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.USER_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.TITLE, R.CONTENT, R.RATING, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS NAME, PI.IMG_URL AS PROD_IMG, GROUP_CONCAT(RI.IMG_URL) AS REVIEW_IMAGES, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT FROM review R INNER JOIN product P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN product_img PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN review_img RI ON R.REVIEW_ID = RI.REVIEW_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR R.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY R.REVIEW_ID ORDER BY R.REVIEW_ID DESC
